items.title: Louis Tio Interview, 1960-10-26
items.q: He turned out a pretty fine little scholar too.

ctx.x: And Simeon too. Simeon and little Elliot Taylor. Oh, he was a good. Yeah. Little Luke of Trell. All of them was his scholars. He had many of them that he turned out, he turned out a lot of white scholars too, but I don't know them so very well. Yeah. And they had Humphrey, Humphrey was a pretty good student also part of my uncle. Which one?
Which, which is the, the young Willie? Willie Humphrey. The young Willie Humphrey. Yeah, yeah, young Willie Humphrey.
